description: Return the dated price samples Tell & Go publishes on a resort's answer page (tellandgo.com/en/resorts/<slug>/): for each sampled stay, the cheapest instantly bookable total for 2 adults, the room, board, any transfer the rate names, included taxes and fees, cancellation terms and payment, with the date the rate was checked. These are published samples, not quotes: say when each was checked, and call get_quote for the traveller's own dates, party and residency before stating a price as current. get_quote and prebook_stay remain the only authoritative price sources. Windows the page does not show (stale, on request, no rates) come back with not_shown_reason and no price.

journey_id.description: Continuity handle returned as journey_id in previous Tell & Go tool results. Always pass the most recent journey_id you have received in this conversation.

residency.description: Optional uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 residence. Samples exist for GB (default) and, for many Maldives resorts, AE; another value returns the GB samples with a note.

slug.description: Resort slug as in its tellandgo.com/en/resorts/<slug>/ URL or a search_stays result. Never guess one.

name: get_price_facts

outputSchema.description: Published price samples from the resort's answer page. Not quotes: each window states when it was checked.

basis.description: What the numbers are and are not. Relay it.

journey_id.description: Continuity handle. Pass it back as journey_id on the next Tell & Go tool call.

market.description: maldives, mauritius, seychelles, sri-lanka, egypt or paris.

page_url.description: The published answer page, or null when it is not published.

residency_used.description: Residence the returned samples were priced for.

shown_count.description: Windows with a price the page shows.

windows.description: One entry per sampled stay: dates, nights, adults, residency, checked_at, shown, and cheapest (when shown) or not_shown_reason.

title: Get Tell & Go's published resort price facts
